findings.highlight: My hand goes to the door to slide it open and tiptoe by
findings.evidenceJa: 足音を殺して部屋の襖に手をかけた
findings.governingReading: Shirou suppresses his footsteps and puts his hand on his room’s sliding door.
findings.explanation: The stealth movement becomes a sentence in which Shirou’s hand grammatically performs the tiptoeing.

findings.evidenceJa: 座敷で眠っている藤ねえたちに気づかれないよう
findings.governingReading: Shirou moves quietly so the sleeping group—Fuji-nee, Saber, and Sakura—will not notice him.
findings.explanation: Fuji-nee and the others sleeping in the sitting room become Fuji-nee alone.

findings.highlight: persistence is how long one can maintain the accuracy and piercing strength.
findings.evidenceJa: 中貫の力を長く維持する厳しさ
findings.governingReading: 久 is described as the demanding discipline of maintaining accuracy and penetrating force over a long time.
findings.explanation: The third element of the archery maxim loses the rigor required to sustain the first two and becomes duration itself.

findings.highlight: I think I read it somewhere in an archery manual.
findings.evidenceJa: たしか中要秘刊集あたりにあった言葉だ
findings.governingReading: He thinks the saying was in something around or like the Chūyō Hikan-shū, preserving uncertainty about the exact source while still naming it.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative recollection of a named archery text is reduced to an unnamed manual.

findings.highlight: Once one aims to be a shooter
findings.evidenceJa: 一度射手たらんと志す者
findings.governingReading: The maxim addresses one who resolves to become an archer or bowman.
findings.explanation: A person aspiring to become an archer is called a “shooter,” flattening the kyūdō register into an unnatural generic term.

findings.highlight: I need to repeat it so that I don't forget the sensation, or else it would be a waste.
findings.evidenceJa: 繰り返して、確実にモノにしなければ勿体ない
findings.governingReading: Before the sensation fades, he must repeat the exercise until he has reliably internalized it; failing to capitalize on the rare success would be wasteful.
findings.explanation: Repeating the successful Strengthening loses Shirou’s goal of making the sensation securely his own.
